name: Sheresh
overview: Sheresh is a male member of the tribe of Manasseh, identified uniquely as the son of Machir and Maacah. His mention in Scripture is brief, with no additional notes or narrative details provided. He is primarily known through his genealogical connection within the tribe of Manasseh.
namesAndTitles: The name Sheresh means 'root, rootstock, sucker [of a plant],' reflecting a Hebrew proper name. This meaning may symbolically relate to lineage or growth, though the name itself was not given by God according to the biblical record.
familyAndRelationships: Sheresh is explicitly recorded as the son of Machir and Maacah. Beyond this direct parentage, Scripture does not provide further family relationships or descendants for Sheresh.
scriptureSignificance: Sheresh's significance lies in his place within the genealogical records of the tribe of Manasseh, as detailed in 1 Chronicles 7:16. His mention helps preserve the lineage and tribal identity important to Israel's history and God's covenant people. While not a prominent figure in biblical narratives, his inclusion underscores the faithfulness of God in maintaining the family lines of His chosen tribes.
